description: This file defines the Android Fragment 'ScopedDirectoryAccessFragment' which manages directory access via StorageManager and DocumentsContract, allowing users to navigate and select directories with scoped permissions. It includes UI setup, handling directory listing, and managing storage volume access intents.

classes.name: ScopedDirectoryAccessFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment that enables users to browse, select, and display directory contents with scoped storage permissions.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up event listeners, restores state.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from directory access intents, grants persistable URI permissions, and updates directory entries.

methods.name: updateDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Queries ContentResolver to list directory contents and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: getDirectoryName
methods.description: Maps spinner selection to corresponding environment directory constants.
